details.question: Calculate the difference of the total amount spent in all events by the Student_Club in year 2019 and 2020.
details.sql:
WITH year_totals AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM expense_date::date) AS year,
        SUM(cost) AS total_spent
    FROM expense e
    JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
    WHERE e.approved::boolean = TRUE
        AND ma.major_name = 'Student_Club'
        AND expense_date::date >= '2019-01-01'
        AND expense_date::date < '2021-01-01'
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM expense_date::date)
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2019 THEN total_spent ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN total_spent ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM year_totals

details.question: Among all the closed events, which event has the highest spend-to-budget ratio?
details.sql:
WITH budget_utilization AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    b.amount,
    b.spent,
    (CAST(b.spent AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) as spend_to_budget_ratio
  FROM budget b
  JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE b.event_status = 'closed'
)
SELECT event_name, spend_to_budget_ratio FROM budget_utilization ORDER BY spend_to_budget_ratio DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: Based on the total cost for all event, what is the percentage of cost for Yearly Kickoff event?

details.question: Indicate the name of the closed event whose cost has exceeded the budget the most.
details.sql:
WITH budget_utilization AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    b.amount,
    b.spent,
    (CAST(b.spent AS NUMERIC) - b.amount) as excess_cost
  FROM budget b
  JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE e.status = 'closed'
)
SELECT event_name
FROM budget_utilization
ORDER BY excess_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE b.category = 'Food'

details.question: List the name of students that have attended more than 7 events.
details.sql: SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM member m JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_event) > 7

details.question: Which student has been entrusted to manage the budget for the Yearly Kickoff?
details.sql: SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM member m JOIN event ev ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' AND m.position = 'Budget Manager'

details.question: Which event has the lowest cost?
details.sql: SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, b.spent as cost FROM event e JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event ORDER BY b.spent ASC LIMIT 1

details.question: Based on the total cost for all event, what is the percentage of cost for Yearly Kickoff event?
details.sql: WITH total_cost AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) as total_cost FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id ), yearly_kickoff_cost AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) as kickoff_cost FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type = 'Yearly Kickoff' ) SELECT ROUND(((ck.kickoff_cost / NULLIF(tc.total_cost, 0)) * 100)::numeric, 2) as cost_percentage FROM total_cost tc, yearly_kickoff_cost ck

details.question: Indicate the top source of funds received in September 2019 based on their amount.
details.sql: SELECT source, SUM(amount) as total_amount FROM income WHERE date_received >= '2019-09-01' AND date_received < '2019-10-01' GROUP BY source ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: How many members of the Student_Club have major in 'Physics Teaching'?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(m.member_id) AS member_count FROM member m JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id WHERE ma.major_name = 'Physics Teaching' AND m.position = 'Student_Club'

details.question: Name the event with the highest amount spent on advertisement.
details.sql:
SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'advertisement'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY SUM(b.spent) DESC
LIMIT 1

details.question: Did Maya Mclean attend the 'Women's Soccer' event?
details.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "attended" FROM "attendance" a JOIN "event" e ON a."link_to_event" = e."event_id" JOIN "member" m ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id" WHERE e."event_name" = 'Women''s Soccer' AND m."first_name" = 'Maya' AND m."last_name" = 'Mclean'

details.question: Indicate the cost of posters for 'September Speaker' event.
details.sql:
SELECT e.expense_id, e.link_to_member, e.cost,
       b.category,
       b.amount AS budget_amount,
       b.spent AS budget_spent,
       ev.event_name AS event_name
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'September Speaker'
  AND e.expense_description LIKE '%posters%'
  AND e.approved::boolean = true

details.question: Indicate the name of the closed event whose cost has exceeded the budget the most.
details.sql:
WITH budget_utilization AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    b.amount,
    b.spent,
    (CAST(b.spent AS NUMERIC) - b.amount) as excess_cost
  FROM budget b
  JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE e.status = 'closed'
)
SELECT event_name
FROM budget_utilization
ORDER BY excess_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

details.question: Identify the type of expenses and their total value approved for 'October Meeting' event.
details.sql:
SELECT b.category AS expense_type, SUM(e.cost) AS total_value
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
  AND e.approved = 'true'
GROUP BY b.category

details.question: Calculate the amount budgeted for 'April Speaker' event. List all the budgeted categories for said event in an ascending order based on their amount budgeted.

details.question: State the category of events were held at MU 215.
details.sql: SELECT "event"."type" AS "type", COUNT(DISTINCT "event"."type") AS "event_type" FROM "event" JOIN "attendance" ON "event"."event_id" = "attendance"."link_to_event" WHERE "event"."location" = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "event"."type" ORDER BY "event_type" ASC LIMIT 100

details.question: List the last name of members with a major in environmental engineering and include its department and college name.

details.question: What are the budget category of the events located at MU 215 and a guest speaker type with a 0 budget spent?
details.sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.category FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.location = 'MU 215' AND e.type = 'guest speaker' AND b.spent = 0 ORDER BY b.category

details.question: Among the members with t-shirt size of medium, what is the percentage of the amount 50 received by the Student_Club?
details.sql: SELECT 50.0 * COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(i.amount) FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE m.t_shirt_size = 'medium'), 0) AS percentage FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE m.t_shirt_size = 'medium' AND i.source = 'Student_Club' AND i.amount = 50

details.question: List the names of closed event as "game" that was closed from 3/15/2019 to 3/20/2020.
Give the full name and contact number of members who had to spend more than average on each expense.
details.sql:
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense WHERE link_to_member = e.link_to_member)

details.question: Write the full name of the member who spent money for water, veggie tray and supplies and include the cost of it.
details.sql:
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE b.category IN ('water', 'veggie tray', 'supplies')
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.category) = 3
